sentences.en: A seed can remain viable for centuries, even millennia.
sentences.zh: 一颗种子甚至可以存活数百年乃至数千年，保持其生命力。

sentences.en: Solar power is becoming more viable every year.
sentences.zh: 太阳能越来越可行，每年都在变得更加实用。

sentences.en: My ideology does not allow me to consider that a viable option.
sentences.zh: 我的理念不允许我将其视为一个可行的选择。
